preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(stdin.split()) == 3 and all(0 <= int(x) <= n - 1 for x in stdin.split()[1].split())
preconditions.description: The second line must contain exactly n-1 integers representing parent indices, each between 0 and n-1.

preconditions.expression: len(stdin.split()[2].split()) == n and all(x in {0, 1} for x in stdin.split()[2].split())
preconditions.description: The third line must contain exactly n integers (0 or 1) representing vertex colors.
At least one vertex must be colored black (1).

postconditions.description: The output must be a non-negative integer less than 10^9 + 7, representing the number of valid edge sets modulo 1000000007.
The output is the count of all possible sets of edges (0 ≤ k < n) whose removal splits the tree into (k + 1) connected components, each containing exactly one black vertex.
